propositions: A central immutable OperationSnapshot must capture validated non-secret effective configuration with explicit source-kind provenance, repository root, and envelope version across CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points.

Composition precedence must be deterministic: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root selected independently via explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/cwd.

Shadow mode composition must thread through all representative operations (ticket/store, LLM-gate, reconcile) without controlling execution or altering ticket/bridge formats, with rollback via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW disabled.
Snapshot construction must exclude live auth objects, secret wrappers, provider clients, and sensitive paths from all fields, serialization, fingerprints, and diagnostics.

Malformed selected operation config must fail-fast with typed config error before lock/network/write effects; any non-config shadow assembly failure must emit redacted warnings and preserve authoritative operation output unchanged.
